name: Ricursive
summary: Ricursive Intelligence is a frontier AI lab using AI to design and improve semiconductor hardware.
overview: Ricursive Intelligence was founded by the co-creators of AlphaChip to build AI systems that accelerate semiconductor design. It announced a $300 million Series A led by Lightspeed at a $4 billion post-money valuation in January 2026.

facts.label: Latest financing
facts.note: Ricursive Intelligence announced a $300 million Series A at a $4 billion valuation.

bull_case: AI-guided chip design can create compounding advantage if it shortens the semiconductor-design loop and produces measurable performance or efficiency gains for customers.
bear_case: Semiconductor design has long sales cycles, incumbent tool vendors and demanding validation requirements. A $4B valuation needs real design wins, not only a strong research pedigree.
latest_round: January 2026 Series A: $300M at a $4B valuation
directory_notes: Public financing and operating data remain limited.

intelligence.description: A frontier AI lab applying machine learning to semiconductor design and AI hardware.
company: Ricursive Intelligence is building AI systems to design and improve AI chips, seeking a feedback loop between better models and better hardware. It was founded by former Google researchers Anna Goldie and Azalia Mirhoseini, co-creators of AlphaChip.

Ricursive announced a $300M Series A at a $4B valuation in January 2026, led by Lightspeed. The company says the capital will accelerate AI-driven semiconductor design; detailed customer and operating metrics remain undisclosed.
intelligence.why_it_matters: Compute demand makes chip design strategically important to the entire AI stack. Ricursive is a high-valuation bet that AI can materially improve the pace and quality of semiconductor development, not merely assist isolated design tasks.

takeaways: Ricursive applies AI to semiconductor and AI-hardware design.
It announced a $300M Series A at a $4B valuation in January 2026.
Customer design wins and verified performance improvements are the key next evidence.
